items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Jack told me he had one, and I've been trying to get Jack... Jack said he had one, he had his picture.

ctx.x: I asked her that, too. She said she did see one once, but she's never been able to find one.
Well, Jack told me he had one, and I've been trying to get Jack, but I'll be Jack this, tell her I, you know, don't be. Yeah. Jack said he had one, he had his picture.
He said he looks a whole lot like one.
